units.title: Real matrix Laplace tail
units.statement: The largest-eigenvalue tail is bounded by the optimized expected trace exponential.
assumptions: Let \((\Omega,\Sigma,\mu)\) be a probability space, let \(\mathcal I\) be finite and nonempty, and let \(X:\Omega\to\operatorname{Mat}_{\mathcal I}(\mathbb R)\) be almost-everywhere strongly measurable and self-adjoint almost everywhere. The threshold \(t\) is any real number.

\(\lambda_{\max}\) denotes the algebraically largest real eigenvalue on the self-adjoint domain; it is not the operator norm. The trace is the ordinary unnormalized trace, and \(e^A\) is the matrix-algebra power-series exponential.

The bar on \(\overline{\mathbb E}\) means a nonnegative scalar integral, permitted to be \(+\infty\). The real coefficient \(e^{-st}\) is finite and strictly positive for every \(s>0\). This is an explicit domain completion of the source inequality, not a claim that the source defines ENNReal or that every matrix MGF exists as a Bochner integral.

Neither centering, independence, a norm cap nor a variance bound is a premise of the public theorem. Almost-everywhere event comparison handles the null exceptional self-adjoint set; no separate eigenbasis selector or general eigenvalue measurability theorem is claimed.

For the private application let \(d,q\in\mathbb N\), \(2q+1<d\), \(r=q+1\), \(\Omega=(\mathbb R^d)^r\), and \(\mu=\gamma_d^{\otimes r}\), with \(\gamma_d=N(0,I_d)\). The case \(q=0\) remains included. Every mean and probability uses this original unconditional law.

For physical rows \(i=1,\ldots,d\), set \(\alpha_i=(i-\tfrac12)\pi/d\), \(t_i=(1,\sqrt2\cos\alpha_i,\ldots,\sqrt2\cos(q\alpha_i))\), \(\Phi_i=(\omega_b(i))_{b=0}^q\), and \(L=2r+3\log(1000d)\). Lean represents physical row \(i\) by \(i.val+1\).

Set \(Y_i=d^{-1}(\Phi_i\Phi_i^\top\otimes t_it_i^\top)\mathbf1_{\{\|\Phi_i\|^2\le L\}}\) and \(Z_i=Y_i-\mathbb E_\mu Y_i\). The cutoff includes equality and uses the same row; the paired index has Gaussian coordinate first, feature coordinate second. The matrices have size \(r^2\times r^2\).

Choose either \(w_i=1\) or \(w_i=\cos((2q+1)\alpha_i)\), and either global sign \(\varepsilon\in\{-1,1\}\). The consumer handles all four matrices \(S=\varepsilon\sum_iw_iZ_i\), every \(s>0\) and every \(a\in\mathbb R\). Actual trace-exponential integrability and positivity are derived inside the proof. No equality of the laws or MGFs of \(S\) and \(-S\) is assumed.
units.reader_note: The first three steps prove the public tail reduction. The last three apply it to all four literal signed Gaussian sums, deriving their finite trace expectations internally.

steps.title: One positive eigenvalue term is bounded by the trace
steps.text: Diagonalize a fixed real self-adjoint matrix. Functional calculus and cyclicity of the unnormalized trace identify the trace exponential with the sum of scalar exponentials. The finite nonempty real spectrum attains its largest element, and its positive exponential is one summand. This pointwise comparison holds for every real s; positivity of s is used later to compare threshold events.
steps.lean:
import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Matrix
import Mathlib.Analysis.Matrix.HermitianFunctionalCalculus
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.ContinuousFunctionalCalculus.ExpLog.Basic
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Integral.Lebesgue.Markov
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Measure.Typeclasses.Probability
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Function.StronglyMeasurable.AEStronglyMeasurable

/-! Real finite-dimensional specialization of Tropp, Proposition 3.1
(author preprint, pp. 9–10). The trace is unnormalized and the largest
eigenvalue is algebraic, rather than the operator norm. The scalar expectation
is an extended nonnegative integral, so positive parameters with infinite
expectation remain legitimate terms of the infimum. This domain completion
does not assert existence of a Bochner matrix moment generating function. -/

open MeasureTheory Unitary
open scoped BigOperators Matrix.Norms.L2Operator ENNReal

noncomputable section
universe u v
namespace AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Probability.MatrixLaplaceTail

private lemma trace_exp_eq_sum
    {ι : Type u} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (s : ℝ) :
    Matrix.trace (NormedSpace.exp (s • A)) =
      ∑ i, Real.exp (s * hA.eigenvalues i) := by
  have heq : cfc (fun x : ℝ => Real.exp (s * x)) A = NormedSpace.exp (s • A) := by
    calc
      _ = cfc Real.exp (s • A) :=
        cfc_comp_const_mul s Real.exp A (by fun_prop) hA.isSelfAdjoint
      _ = _ := CFC.real_exp_eq_normedSpace_exp
        ((IsSelfAdjoint.all s).smul hA.isSelfAdjoint)
  rw [← heq, hA.cfc_eq, Matrix.IsHermitian.cfc,
    conjStarAlgAut_apply, Matrix.trace_mul_cycle, coe_star_mul_self,
    one_mul, Matrix.trace_diagonal]
  simp

private lemma exp_max_eigenvalue_le_trace_exp
    {ι : Type u} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Nonempty ι]
    (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (s : ℝ) :
    Real.exp (s * sSup (spectrum ℝ A)) ≤ Matrix.trace (NormedSpace.exp (s • A)) := by
  rw [trace_exp_eq_sum A hA s]
  have hmem : sSup (spectrum ℝ A) ∈ spectrum ℝ A := by
    rw [hA.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues]
    exact (Set.range_nonempty _).csSup_mem (Set.finite_range _)
  rw [hA.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues] at hmem
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hmem
  rw [hA.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues, ← hi]
  exact Finset.single_le_sum
    (f := fun j => Real.exp (s * hA.eigenvalues j))
    (fun j _ => Real.exp_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_univ i)

steps.title: Use the positive trace observable on the almost-sure domain
steps.text: Fix s>0. Continuity of the matrix exponential and trace makes their scalar composition almost-everywhere measurable. Outside the null exceptional set, λmax(X)≥t implies exp(st)≤tr exp(sX). Compare the event measures almost everywhere. This avoids assuming a measurable eigenbasis or replacing λmax by the norm.
steps.lean:
/-- The matrix Laplace tail bound with AE Hermiticity and extended expectation.
No centering, independence, variance, or one-sided matrix cap is required. -/
theorem max_eigenvalue_tail_le_iInf_trace_exp
    {Ω : Type v} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {ι : Type u} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Nonempty ι]
    (X : Ω → Matrix ι ι ℝ)
    (hX : AEStronglyMeasurable X μ)
    (hherm : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X ω).IsHermitian)
    (t : ℝ) :
    μ {ω | t ≤ sSup (spectrum ℝ (X ω))} ≤
      ⨅ s : {s : ℝ // 0 < s},
        ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(s.val * t))) *
          ∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal (Matrix.trace (NormedSpace.exp (s.val • X ω))) ∂μ := by
  classical
  apply le_iInf
  intro s
  let F : Ω → ℝ≥0∞ := fun ω =>
    ENNReal.ofReal (Matrix.trace (NormedSpace.exp (s.val • X ω)))
  have hcontExp : Continuous (NormedSpace.exp : Matrix ι ι ℝ → Matrix ι ι ℝ) :=
    continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr fun A =>
      (NormedSpace.exp_analytic (𝕂 := ℝ) A).continuousAt
  have hcontTrace : Continuous (Matrix.trace : Matrix ι ι ℝ → ℝ) :=
    (Matrix.traceLinearMap ι ℝ ℝ).continuous_of_finiteDimensional
  have hF : AEMeasurable F μ :=
    ENNReal.measurable_ofReal.comp_aemeasurable
      ((hcontTrace.comp hcontExp).comp_aestronglyMeasurable
        (hX.const_smul s.val)).aemeasurable
  have hinc : {ω | t ≤ sSup (spectrum ℝ (X ω))} ≤ᵐ[μ]
      {ω | ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (s.val * t)) ≤ F ω} := by
    filter_upwards [hherm] with ω hh ht
    apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
    exact (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ht s.property.le)).trans
      (exp_max_eigenvalue_le_trace_exp _ hh s.val)

steps.title: Apply scalar Markov and take the positive-parameter infimum
steps.text: Apply nonnegative Markov to ofReal(tr exp(sX)) at the finite positive threshold exp(st). Divide by that threshold and rewrite its reciprocal as exp(−st). This combines the two elementary source comparisons by applying Markov directly to the trace exponential. Every s>0 gives a bound, so take their infimum. Infinite expectations remain valid terms and do not create a zero-times-infinity case.
steps.lean:
calc
    _ ≤ μ {ω | ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (s.val * t)) ≤ F ω} := measure_mono_ae hinc
    _ ≤ (∫⁻ ω, F ω ∂μ) / ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (s.val * t)) :=
      meas_ge_le_lintegral_div hF
        (by simp only [ne_eq, ENNReal.ofReal_eq_zero]; exact not_le.mpr (Real.exp_pos _))
        ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
    _ = _ := by
      rw [div_eq_mul_inv, ← ENNReal.ofReal_inv_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _), ← Real.exp_neg]
      exact mul_comm _ _

end AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Probability.MatrixLaplaceTail

steps.title: Keep the literal four Gaussian sums and their finite-dimensional semantics
steps.text: The application uses the original product Gaussian experiment, inclusive own-row truncation, actual unconditional means, both deterministic weights and both global signs. Its two private analytic helpers prove an exponential norm bound from a Hermitian norm bound and nonnegativity of the trace exponential by functional calculus. Their estimates are internal proof ingredients.

import AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Probability.MatrixLaplaceTail
import AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.GaussianComplexity.FixedSpectrumSourceMatrixRadius
import AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.GaussianComplexity.FixedSpectrumSourceMatrixStructure
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Integral.Bochner.ContinuousLinearMap

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open scoped BigOperators Matrix.Norms.L2Operator MatrixOrder ENNReal
noncomputable section
universe u
namespace AutoSamplingTheory.Tests.GaussianComplexityLaplaceTail

private lemma hermitian_exp_norm_le
    {ι : Type u} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Nonempty ι]
    (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) {C s : ℝ}
    (hn : ‖A‖ ≤ C) (hs : 0 < s) :
    ‖NormedSpace.exp (s • A)‖ ≤ Real.exp (s * C) := by
  have heq : cfc (fun x : ℝ => Real.exp (s * x)) A = NormedSpace.exp (s • A) := by
    calc
      _ = cfc Real.exp (s • A) :=
        cfc_comp_const_mul s Real.exp A (by fun_prop) hA.isSelfAdjoint
      _ = _ := CFC.real_exp_eq_normedSpace_exp
        ((IsSelfAdjoint.all s).smul hA.isSelfAdjoint)
  rw [← heq]
  apply norm_cfc_le (Real.exp_nonneg _)
  intro x hx
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
  exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    ((Real.le_norm_self x).trans
      ((IsometricContinuousFunctionalCalculus.norm_spectrum_le A hx hA.isSelfAdjoint).trans hn))
    hs.le)

private lemma hermitian_trace_exp_nonneg
    {ι : Type u} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (s : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ Matrix.trace (NormedSpace.exp (s • A)) := by
  have hSA := (IsSelfAdjoint.all s).smul hA.isSelfAdjoint
  have hnonneg : (0 : Matrix ι ι ℝ) ≤ cfc Real.exp (s • A) :=
    cfc_nonneg (fun x _ => Real.exp_nonneg x)
  rw [CFC.real_exp_eq_normedSpace_exp hSA] at hnonneg
  have hPSD : (NormedSpace.exp (s • A)).PosSemidef := by
    simpa only [sub_zero] using Matrix.le_iff.mp hnonneg
  exact hPSD.trace_nonneg

private theorem actual_source_four_sums_laplace_tail :
∀ {d q : ℕ} (hq : 2 * q + 1 < d),
  let D := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)
  let E := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (q + 1))
  let Ω := Fin (q + 1) → D
  let μ : Measure Ω := Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin (q + 1) => stdGaussian D)
  let M := Matrix (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ
  let r : ℝ := ((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
  let L : ℝ := 2 * r + 3 * Real.log (1000 * (d : ℝ))
  let α : Fin d → ℝ := fun i => ((i.val : ℝ) + 1 - 1 / 2) * Real.pi / (d : ℝ)
  let tvec : Fin d → Fin (q + 1) → ℝ := fun i k =>
    if k.val = 0 then 1 else Real.sqrt 2 * Real.cos ((k.val : ℝ) * α i)
  let row : Fin d → Ω → E := fun i ω =>
    WithLp.toLp 2 (fun b : Fin (q + 1) => ω b i)
  let Y : Fin d → Ω → M := fun i ω =>
    if ‖row i ω‖ ^ 2 ≤ L then
      (d : ℝ)⁻¹ • Matrix.kronecker
        (Matrix.vecMulVec (WithLp.ofLp (row i ω)) (WithLp.ofLp (row i ω)))
        (Matrix.vecMulVec (tvec i) (tvec i))
    else 0
  let mean : Fin d → M := fun i => ∫ ω, Y i ω ∂μ
  let Z : Fin d → Ω → M := fun i ω => Y i ω - mean i
  let w : Bool → Fin d → ℝ := fun useCos i =>
    if useCos = true then Real.cos (((2 * q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * α i) else 1
  let sign : Bool → ℝ := fun minus => if minus = true then -1 else 1
  let S : Bool → Bool → Ω → M := fun useCos minus ω =>
    sign minus • ∑ i : Fin d, w useCos i • Z i ω
  ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → ∀ a : ℝ, ∀ useCos minus : Bool,
    μ {ω | a ≤ sSup (spectrum ℝ (S useCos minus ω))} ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal
        (Real.exp (-(s * a)) *
          ∫ ω, Matrix.trace (NormedSpace.exp (s • S useCos minus ω)) ∂μ)
 := by

steps.title: Reuse genuine source structure and radius to bound all four sums
steps.text: The canonical source-structure parent supplies measurability and Hermiticity under the original experiment; its own mean-integrability prerequisites are already proved in its dependency closure. The source-radius parent supplies the truncated matrix and actual mean bounds. Triangle and scalar norm inequalities give a finite uniform bound for each weighted signed sum. Independence and centering from the structure package are not used by this probability reduction.
steps.lean:
classical
  intro d q hq
  dsimp only
  let D := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)
  let E := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (q + 1))
  let Ω := Fin (q + 1) → D
  let μ : Measure Ω := Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin (q + 1) => stdGaussian D)
  let M := Matrix (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ
  let r : ℝ := ((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
  let L : ℝ := 2 * r + 3 * Real.log (1000 * (d : ℝ))
  let α : Fin d → ℝ := fun i => ((i.val : ℝ) + 1 - 1 / 2) * Real.pi / (d : ℝ)
  let tvec : Fin d → Fin (q + 1) → ℝ := fun i k =>
    if k.val = 0 then 1 else Real.sqrt 2 * Real.cos ((k.val : ℝ) * α i)
  let row : Fin d → Ω → E := fun i ω =>
    WithLp.toLp 2 (fun b : Fin (q + 1) => ω b i)
  let Y : Fin d → Ω → M := fun i ω =>
    if ‖row i ω‖ ^ 2 ≤ L then
      (d : ℝ)⁻¹ • Matrix.kronecker
        (Matrix.vecMulVec (WithLp.ofLp (row i ω)) (WithLp.ofLp (row i ω)))
        (Matrix.vecMulVec (tvec i) (tvec i))
    else 0
  let mean : Fin d → M := fun i => ∫ ω, Y i ω ∂μ
  let Z : Fin d → Ω → M := fun i ω => Y i ω - mean i
  let w : Bool → Fin d → ℝ := fun useCos i =>
    if useCos = true then Real.cos (((2 * q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * α i) else 1
  let sign : Bool → ℝ := fun minus => if minus = true then -1 else 1
  let S : Bool → Bool → Ω → M := fun useCos minus ω =>
    sign minus • ∑ i : Fin d, w useCos i • Z i ω
  let ρ : ℝ := 2 * r * (L + 1) / (d : ℝ)
  letI : MeasurableSpace M := borel M
  letI : BorelSpace M := ⟨rfl⟩
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure μ := by
    dsimp only [μ]
    infer_instance
  change ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → ∀ a : ℝ, ∀ useCos minus : Bool,
    μ {ω | a ≤ sSup (spectrum ℝ (S useCos minus ω))} ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(s * a)) *
        ∫ ω, Matrix.trace (NormedSpace.exp (s • S useCos minus ω)) ∂μ)
  have hstructure :=
    AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.GaussianComplexity.FixedSpectrumSourceMatrixStructure.actual_source_centered_matrix_structure
      (d := d) (q := q) hq
  change (∀ j : Fin d, Measurable (Z j)) ∧ iIndepFun Z μ ∧
    (∀ j : Fin d, Integrable (Z j) μ) ∧
    (∀ j : Fin d, (∫ ω, Z j ω ∂μ) = 0) ∧
    (∀ j : Fin d, ∀ ω : Ω, (Z j ω).IsHermitian) at hstructure
  rcases hstructure with ⟨hmeasZ, _, _, _, hhermZ⟩
  have radius :=
    AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.GaussianComplexity.FixedSpectrumSourceMatrixRadius.actual_source_truncated_matrix_norm_bounds
      (d := d) (q := q) hq
  change (∀ j : Fin d, ∀ ω : Ω, ‖Y j ω‖ ≤ 2 * r * L / (d : ℝ)) ∧
    (∀ j : Fin d, ‖mean j‖ ≤ 2 * r / (d : ℝ)) at radius
  have hd2 : 2 ≤ d := by omega
  have hd2R : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (d : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hd2
  have hdpos : (0 : ℝ) < d := by linarith
  have hrpos : 0 < r := by dsimp only [r]; positivity
  have hlog : 0 ≤ Real.log (1000 * (d : ℝ)) := Real.log_nonneg (by nlinarith)
  have hLpos : 0 < L + 1 := by dsimp only [L]; nlinarith
  have hnormZ (j : Fin d) (ω : Ω) : ‖Z j ω‖ ≤ ρ := by
    change ‖Y j ω - mean j‖ ≤ ρ
    calc
      _ ≤ ‖Y j ω‖ + ‖mean j‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
      _ ≤ 2 * r * L / (d : ℝ) + 2 * r / (d : ℝ) :=
        add_le_add (radius.1 j ω) (radius.2 j)
      _ = ρ := by dsimp only [ρ]; ring
  have hw (useCos : Bool) (j : Fin d) : ‖w useCos j‖ ≤ 1 := by
    by_cases h : useCos = true
    · simpa only [w, if_pos h, Real.norm_eq_abs] using Real.abs_cos_le_one
        (((2 * q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * α j)
    · simp only [w, if_neg h, norm_one, le_refl]
  have hnormS (useCos minus : Bool) (ω : Ω) : ‖S useCos minus ω‖ ≤ (d : ℝ) * ρ := by
    have hsign : ‖sign minus‖ = 1 := by cases minus <;> norm_num [sign]
    change ‖sign minus • ∑ j : Fin d, w useCos j • Z j ω‖ ≤ _
    rw [norm_smul, hsign, one_mul]
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ j : Fin d, ‖w useCos j • Z j ω‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ _ : Fin d, ρ := Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => by
        rw [norm_smul]
        exact (mul_le_mul (hw useCos j) (hnormZ j ω) (norm_nonneg _) (by norm_num)).trans_eq
          (one_mul _)
      _ = (d : ℝ) * ρ := by simp
  have hmeasS (useCos minus : Bool) : Measurable (S useCos minus) := by
    exact (Finset.measurable_sum _ (fun j _ => (hmeasZ j).const_smul (w useCos j))).const_smul
      (sign minus)
  have hhermS (useCos minus : Bool) (ω : Ω) : (S useCos minus ω).IsHermitian := by
    exact ((IsSelfAdjoint.all (sign minus)).smul
      (isSelfAdjoint_sum _ fun j _ =>
        (IsSelfAdjoint.all (w useCos j)).smul (hhermZ j ω).isSelfAdjoint)).isHermitian
  intro s hs a useCos minus

steps.title: Prove the actual trace expectation finite and apply the public theorem
steps.text: For each fixed positive s, functional calculus and the uniform bound yield ||exp(sS)||≤exp(sdρ). Hence the matrix exponential is Bochner integrable, and the continuous linear trace map gives scalar trace integrability. Its nonnegativity then converts the nonnegative integral to ofReal of the actual Bochner expectation. Specialize the public infimum at this s to obtain the four-family conclusion with no integrability premise added.
steps.lean:
have hcontExp : Continuous (NormedSpace.exp : M → M) :=
    continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr fun A =>
      (NormedSpace.exp_analytic (𝕂 := ℝ) A).continuousAt
  have hintExp : Integrable (fun ω => NormedSpace.exp (s • S useCos minus ω)) μ := by
    apply Integrable.of_bound
      (hcontExp.comp_aestronglyMeasurable
        ((hmeasS useCos minus).aestronglyMeasurable.const_smul s))
      (Real.exp (s * ((d : ℝ) * ρ)))
    exact ae_of_all _ fun ω => hermitian_exp_norm_le _ (hhermS useCos minus ω)
      (hnormS useCos minus ω) hs
  have hintTrace : Integrable
      (fun ω => Matrix.trace (NormedSpace.exp (s • S useCos minus ω))) μ :=
    (Matrix.traceLinearMap _ ℝ ℝ).toContinuousLinearMap.integrable_comp hintExp
  have htraceNonneg : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ,
      0 ≤ Matrix.trace (NormedSpace.exp (s • S useCos minus ω)) :=
    ae_of_all _ fun ω => hermitian_trace_exp_nonneg _ (hhermS useCos minus ω) s
  have htail :=
    AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Probability.MatrixLaplaceTail.max_eigenvalue_tail_le_iInf_trace_exp
      μ (S useCos minus) (hmeasS useCos minus).aestronglyMeasurable
      (ae_of_all _ (hhermS useCos minus)) a
  calc
    _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(s * a))) *
        ∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal (Matrix.trace (NormedSpace.exp (s • S useCos minus ω))) ∂μ :=
      htail.trans (iInf_le _ (⟨s, hs⟩ : {x : ℝ // 0 < x}))
    _ = _ := by
      rw [← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hintTrace htraceNonneg,
        ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (Real.exp_nonneg _)]

end AutoSamplingTheory.Tests.GaussianComplexityLaplaceTail

units.dependency_notes: Public P has no ASTIS mathematical parent; its two private spectral helpers depend only on Mathlib.
